title: An everywhere-defined graded Proj immersion detects relative ampleness
statement: Let $h:Z\to S$ be a quasi-compact morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}\mathcal A_d$ be a quasi-coherent graded commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra, def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. It need not be generated in degree one and $\mathcal A_0$ need not equal $\mathcal O_S$. Suppose $\psi:h^*\mathcal A\to\bigoplus_{d\ge0}L^{\otimes d}$ is a graded algebra homomorphism [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $U(\psi)$ be the union, over $d\ge1$, of the open loci on which $\psi_d:h^*\mathcal A_d\to L^{\otimes d}$ is surjective, and let $r_{L,\psi}:U(\psi)\to\operatorname{Proj}_S(\mathcal A)$ be the canonical morphism [lem-trf-space-line-module-proj-map, def-nagata-relative-proj]. If $U(\psi)=Z$ and $r_{L,\psi}$ is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], then $L|_{h^{-1}(V)}$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] for every affine open $V\subseteq S$.

source.place: Tag 01VJ (lemma-characterize-relatively-ample), implication (6) implies (1), with the generation locus and canonical map from Constructions Tag 01O9 (lemma-invertible-map-into-relative-proj).

proof.text: Fix an affine V, set T=h^{-1}(V) and M=h|_T^*L. Quasi-compactness of h makes T compact. Since r is over S, its restriction lifts through the relative-Proj chart. Transport the submodule grading to additive subgroups by the identity graded-ring isomorphism. The proved private helpers transport the unit and multiplication equations for psi through the normalized pullback and tensor-power comparisons and extend the additive degree maps through DirectSum.decomposeRingEquiv. This constructs the normalized graded map phi. For generation, refine the affine neighbourhood from GeneratesEverywhere inside its intersection with V. Degreewise base-change induction shows that, if every image from A(V)_n were in the maximal ideal times the stalk, every image from the refinement would be also, contradicting the generating section. The fibre comparison for tensor pullback preserves nonvanishing; the tensor-power comparison preserves it as an isomorphism. Thus the positive images of phi cover T. Apply [lem-trf-relative-graded-map-affine-chart] to this map and cover to obtain the basic-open and fraction formulas for the lifted map.

source.place: Tag 01VJ, proof of (6) implies (1), affine reduction; Constructions Tag 01O9, affine restriction and canonical map.

proof.text: The morphism $r:T\to P$ is an immersion and $T$ is quasi-compact, since $h$ is quasi-compact and $V$ is affine. By [lemma-nagata-immersion-shrink-to-closed-exists] there is a quasi-compact open $Y\subseteq P$ containing $r(T)$ such that the induced morphism $i:T\to Y$ is a closed immersion; with $u:Y\to P$ the open inclusion, $r=u\circ i$.

source.place: Tag 01VJ, proof of (6) implies (1), paragraph asserting that quasi-compact X is a closed subscheme of a quasi-compact open Y in Proj(A).

proof.text: The absolute canonical-map twist comparison [lem-trf-proj-canonical-map-twist-comparison], applied to Step 1, gives d>0 and identifications rho^*O(dk) ≅ M^(dk) for every k>0. The hypotheses include the quasi-compactness from Step 1 and exactly the supplied preimage and fraction formulas.

source.place: Tag 01VJ, proof of (6) implies (1), using Properties Tags 01PU and 01Q2.

proof.text: The quasi-compact-open theorem [lem-trf-proj-qc-open-twist-ample] supplies e>0 such that O_Y(ek) is invertible and ample for every k>0. Use k=d and pull back along the closed immersion i by [lem-trf-ample-restrict-closed-immersion]. The composition comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] and tensor-versus-ordinary pullback comparison [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison] identify this object with rho^*O(ed). Step 3 at k=e and ed=de identify it with M^(de); ampleness is preserved by this isomorphism [lem-sc-ample-iso]. The stronger every-multiple ampleness clause avoids applying a separate ample-positive-tensor-power theorem.

source.place: Tag 01VJ, proof of (6) implies (1), paragraphs on the pullback of O(d) and ampleness of a quasi-compact open of Proj.

proof.text: The private proved helper isAmple_of_positive_tensorPow unfolds [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Given an affine nonvanishing section of (M^(de))^n, use tensorPowMulIso to regard it as a section of M^(de*n). Isomorphisms preserve the nonvanishing locus, so the same affine neighbourhood and the positive exponent de*n witness ampleness of M. Compactness is already part of the positive-power ampleness hypothesis. This works for each affine V and also for empty T.

source.place: Tag 01VJ, conclusion of (6) implies (1), together with Definition 01PS of ample and Definition 01VH of relatively ample.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01VJ, (6) implies (1), with the affine canonical-map characterization of Constructions 01O9 and 01NK. Use the every-multiple ampleness clause of the quasi-compact-open theorem directly; use the definition for the descent of ampleness from a positive power.
